title: dryopteris leuzeana
intro: Dryopteris leuzeana, commonly known as Leuze's wood fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris leuzeana include its antihypertensive, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which help to reduce blood pressure, alleviate pain, and promote urine production. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
